These are the files generated by Jillian Cwycyshyn (2025) for the revised HSC paper.

# Files
- `fib_ihsc_processed.h5ad` - Processed/harmonized gene counts for control fibroblasts and reprogrammed cells
- `three_libraries_new.h5ad` - Processed/harmonized gene counts for control, reprogrammed cells, and bone marrow data
- `isoforms.h5ad` - Isoform counts for control, reprogrammed cells, and bone marrow data
- `Ng_2024_raw.h5ad` - Raw counts from Ng 2024
- `single_cell_atlas.h5ad` - Integrated reference atlas (native and engineered cell types)
- `single_cell_atlas_embedding_v2.h5ad` - scVI-corrected embedding (UMAP) for integrated reference atlas
- `atlas_v2_scvicounts.h5ad` - scVI counts for integrated reference atlas
